+# Incident Postmortem: Search Endpoint Latency & Provider Error Spike
+
+## Summary
+The `booklogr-api` service experienced high p99 HTTP request latency (>2.4s), triggering `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High`, `BookMetadataProviderErrorsElevated`, and `EdgeClientRequestJitter` alerts. The issue was resolved by fixing the search route cache key generation logic to incorporate both user ID and query parameters, and re-enabling response caching (`SimpleCache`).
+
+## Root Cause
+In commit `8c580a7d5978fbd6d87a9cf12f16653a39aa2d94` ("Scope search cache key to the authenticated user"), a custom lambda key prefix (`key_prefix=lambda: f"view/{get_current_user_id()}/{request.path}"`) was added to `@cache.cached()`. In Flask-Caching, specifying a callable `key_prefix` overrides default key generation and ignores `query_string=True`, causing all search queries for a given user to evaluate to the same cache key (`view/{user_id}/v1/books/search`).
+
+To prevent returning incorrect cached search results across different queries, commit `f1276612dfa530d4f49189c352014d3706ce7e24` ("Disable response caching") set `CACHE_TYPE = "NullCache"`. With caching disabled, every incoming `/v1/books/search` request performed an un-cached synchronous HTTP lookup to the external `book-metadata` provider (`http://book-metadata:8080`), which takes ~1.2s per request. Under continuous traffic load, this caused request queueing, elevated p99 search latency (~2.48s), 5xx errors on the metadata provider due to rate limits/overload, and edge client latency jitter.
+
+## Evidence Used
+1. Alertmanager firing alerts:
+   - `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High`: p99 latency at 2.48s (threshold 300ms).
+   - `BookMetadataProviderErrorsElevated`: 5xx error rate > 5% on `book-metadata` search endpoint.
+   - `EdgeClientRequestJitter`: Traffic generator experiencing request jitter.
+2. Prometheus metrics:
+   - `flask_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket` showed `/v1/books/search` requests taking 1.0s to 2.5s.
+   - `book_metadata_provider_errors_total` and `book_metadata_request_duration_seconds_bucket` confirmed latency bottleneck and error spikes at `book-metadata:8080`.
+3. Git History Analysis:
+   - Commit `8c580a7` introduced `key_prefix=lambda: f"view/{get_current_user_id()}/{request.path}"` which broke query-string cache differentiation.
+   - Commit `f127661` set `CACHE_TYPE = "NullCache"`, causing 100% of search traffic to hit the slow upstream metadata provider.
+
+## Changes Made
+1. **`api/routes/books.py`**: Defined `make_search_cache_key()` to dynamically build cache keys combining user ID, path, and sorted request query parameters (`qs = "&".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(request.args.items()))`). Updated decorator to `@cache.cached(key_prefix=make_search_cache_key)`.
+2. **`api/config.py`**: Changed `CACHE_TYPE` from `"NullCache"` back to `"SimpleCache"`.
